attchmntText: Technocraft Industries (India) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
Technocraft Industries (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Technocraft Industries (India) Limited has scheduled a conference call for Monday, November 16, 2026, at 11:30 hrs IST to discuss financial performance for the Second Quarter ended September 30, 2026. The call will feature management representatives including Dr. Sharad Kumar Saraf, Mr. Sudarshan Kumar Saraf, Mr. Navneet Kumar Saraf, Mr. Ashish Kumar Saraf, and Mr. Anil Gadodia. The event is organized by 360 ONE CM Research. Participants can join via the provided Diamond pass link or dial-in numbers. Contact details for further information are available for Purva Zanwar and Akhil Parekh at 360 ONE Capital Market Research.
